text:
emma: Quick design review — thinking about compressing the IP probe results in the Private setup wizard. Current rows are big; proposals: single-line summary per host with a chevron to expand details. Saves vertical space for long lists. Thoughts? :eyes:
aj: +1 to compacting. A couple concerns: 1) summary must clearly convey pass/warn/fail (not just color), 2) need a visible affordance for expanding (not icon-only), 3) keyboard focus target for each expandable row. I mocked one up: https://figma.com/s/compact-probes
kai: Nice. For layout suggestion — show: Host | status pill + short text | last checked | actions. Keep status pill 32px high so rows can be 40px total. Avoid wrapping long hostnames, ellipsize with tooltip.
sana: Accessibility nits: when collapsed, include an accessible summary like "db-01.example.com: 1 open port, probe succeeded" (sr text). Use aria-expanded on the chevron button, and aria-controls to correlate details panel. Also use an aria-live region to announce state changes (polite) when probe results update. Avoid relying on color alone.
devin: Implementation notes: we can do a collapsed state using a single div with role="button" and tabindex="0" plus <button aria-expanded="false">Details</button>. CSS: compact row = 40px, font-size 13px. For status we use class names: .status--ok .status--warn .status--fail and include visible label e.g. "OK"/"Partial"/"Blocked". Example snippet: <button class=\"probe-toggle\" aria-expanded=\"false\">Details ▸</button>
lina: From support POV — please add a short human-friendly line in the summary for failures to help customers triage: e.g., "egress blocked — try SSH test: nc -vz 10.0.0.4 443". Also a link or copy button to copy suggested commands. That reduces first-response time.
emma: Agreed. Copy suggestions for failure states: 1) "Egress blocked — check firewall/CIDR" 2) "Port unreachable — verify service listening" 3) "DNS unresolved — check hostname or internal DNS" Keep them 1 line each.
sana: On screen-reader behavior: when user expands details, speak a short sentence summarizing results then offer a short list of diagnostics. Use role="region" and aria-live="polite" on the details panel so NVDA/VoiceOver pick up the new content. Also ensure the expand control is in tab order before the actions column.
aj: Visual contrast: status pills need 4.5:1 ratio for text. For green/amber/red, use darker text or include a dark outline. Also consider adding an icon + label for quick scanning.
devin: Performance: rendering 200 probe rows — virtualization is fine. We'll lazy-render expanded panels. Also will add telemetry hook when users click "copy command" for support flow.
ci-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/compact-probes - branch: feature/compact-probes (demo data).
lina: Speaking points for support agents (short): - "If probe shows egress blocked, ask for firewall rules and CIDR; ask them to run provided copy command and paste output." - "If host unreachable, ask for service logs and last-deploy time." I'll add to the KB once we finalize wording.
emma: Action items: AJ to update figma with accessibility annotations; DEVIN to prototype collapsed row + aria attributes; SANA to write short SR guidance; LINA to draft support KB lines. We'll review next Wed. :thumbsup:
